description_en: Replaces all object binding information under a specified data source
description_zh: 用于全量替换指定数据源下的对象绑定信息
name: ReplaceObjectBindings

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. Pass it explicitly through winnexo-cli using --tenant-id
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 --tenant-id 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the personal FILE data source to be replaced (unique within the tenant)
parameters.help_zh: 待替换的个人 FILE 数据源 ID（租户内唯一）
parameters.name: source_id

fields.help_en: The semantic graph name to which the binding object belongs (object_id is unique within this graph. Required)
fields.help_zh: 绑定对象归属的语义图谱名（object_id 在该 graph 下唯一，必填）
fields.name: graph_name

fields.help_en: The binding object type (such as customer or project)
fields.help_zh: 绑定对象类型（如 customer / project）
fields.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The new list of object bindings (full replacement. Pass an empty list to clear all bindings)
parameters.help_zh: 新的对象绑定列表（全量替换；传空列表表示清空所有绑定）
parameters.name: object_bindings
